admission.justification: Two different claims are now kept apart: no counter and no per-agent, task, master or workspace token figure replaces the removed cost view, and AR reads the host's usage report in one place for the limit only. The preserved absence claims are held by the dashboard absence tests (master reader, cockpit) and the no-usage-figure rules; the admitted reader is held by its own cases for the report judgement, the file and the hold, so the justification no longer rests on an empty usage-read diff.

applicability: Every limit the product attributes to a role seat, and every read of the host's usage report.
conditions: The report is available, and at least one of its account-wide windows is exhausted with a future reset and not covered by a live suppression for (reportId, windowId, resetsAt); a scoped window does not hold a seat.

Enabled extra usage or a credits balance above zero releases the seat; window-scoped suppressions stored in provider-limit-suppressions.json filter exhausted windows through one shared projection helper.

One reader, one locked file pair, and one answer at a time: serving.paseo.provider_limits writes provider-limit-suppressions.json and strictly ar-provider-limits/v1 provider-limits.json atomically under provider-limits.lock, and every other reader reads provider-limits.json only.
A read happens at a new stamped turn end or when a live report is due for its five-minute recheck; the due attempt is recorded before the host call, and a failed or empty answer keeps the prior fact.
exclusions: No token number per agent, task, master or workspace is shown, and no usage figure beyond rule 13's word and hover is displayed.
Chat text, error text and model names produce no limit, and no API key or login store is read.

evidence: git diff --stat (those paths absent); dashboard Chats-view picture shows no usage line

statement: AR reads the host's usage report in one place and for the limit only: a report holds work solely on an unsuppressed exhausted account-wide window, and enabled extra usage, positive credits, or window-scoped suppression releases covered windows.
title: Single-place usage reader projects unsuppressed limits to v1 file
